HyperVibe is installed

HyperVibe opens automatically and shows a live System Check. macOS keeps privacy permissions under your control, so follow the two clearly marked required rows there. Their status updates as soon as you return from System Settings — no relaunch is needed.

HyperVibe 会自动启动并显示实时“系统检查”。请按照其中两项明确标记的必需权限操作；从系统设置返回后状态会自动更新，无需重启 App。
